title: INNO3D GeForce RTX 5060 Ti Twin X2 16GB Video Card $709 Delivered @ Mwave
body:
Deal: INNO3D GeForce RTX 5060 Ti Twin X2 16GB Video Card $709 Delivered @ Mwave

[Franc-T] Thats a crazy good price compared to everyone else
[Wolfy] Lets see if they honour it or ignore & delay until it gets cancelled (as per many recent Reddit comments).
[boozed] Well at least it costs less than the alternatives that massively outperform it again
[P1nk] Bought it to replace my trusty 2080ti
Thanks OP
[Sertacv2] I didnt even need this & bought it. Already got a 9060xt
[19199090] Another price error from Mwave, not as good as last nights 2x16gb ddr5 for $206 though
[dqtl74] Insane that not too long ago you could get a 9070 (non-XT) for around this price and it absolutely crushes the 5060 Ti.
[nov1911] drivers are better too
I'm selling my 4080 as soon as I see a good price for a 9070 or xt cause I'm still on 2 year old drivers as the newer ones are all very unstable and buggy
[Slurped] I was under the impression that AMD had the driver issues. What issues are you having with the newer drivers ?
[nov1911] that used to be the case a few generations ago, now its flipped
just small things that add up, from minor stuff to black screen for a few seconds when going from fullscreen to minimize, or changing resolutions takes 5-10 seconds to a really annoying bug where if I do one thing like play a game I then need to restart the PC to use photoshop or a video editor otherwise the PC slows to a crawl and clicking one thing takes 10 seconds+ for it to work
it's mostly fine on driver 566 but new games can have issues and I'm just over it
there's plenty of complaints on reddit if you care to check
[AcidMuddycrabs] I sold my 4080 super in may for 1400 it was a tuf model and snagged a 9070xt for 790 glad I did it at the time perf on linux (cachy os) is wayy better than nvidia counterpart.
[nov1911] I'm doing the same, sick of windows, gonna give cachy a try
[misunderstood98] It wins in raster, yes, but for neural rendering, sadly the 9070 doesn't have the same support as the Blackwell's cards. Even with the lower bus, the gddr7 with the new cores put this card in a very nice spot.
A 5070ti rendering the full game and pushing post-processing frames to a 5060ti for dlss5 rendering will achieve higher frames than a 5090. The caveat to this is the quality will be lesser, given the 5060ti doesn't have vector information etc.
But again, this isn't something that is very easy to do with AMDs pipeline yet
[goodwillN1] Does DLSS5 actually use vectoring info? I thought it is just an AI post process filter… Unlike the other DLSS versions
[aaronsd] DLSS5 does use vector information and it's not even an image upscaler anymore, it's something much more of a beast now.
I also saw that recently DLSS5 has been ported over to work on AMD graphics cards too, verified on 90-series cards of theirs. Which is absolutely nuts!
[Cyprella] Thanks OP. Great deal. Order placed. Lets see if they fulfill.
Bit overkill but will be great connected to the 4K TV for moonlight game streaming in AV1 HDMI2.1 VRR (From the 5080 in the main pc). I guess at this point with DLSS and framegen it probably can even just play the game locally!!
Handy also serving as 16gb for crappy local LLM's and tdarr AV1 encoding node.
[jaimex2] For those impulse buying know this should have been the 5050 rtx. It certainly performs like it.
Its not remotely good value.
[Franc-T] No video card is good value, but the 5060 Ti 16Gb is decent.
[MaxHashrate] Bought one, most likely a price error but heck… these cards with 16gb are high for a reason.
https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/gpus/astonishing-…
Return of SLI
[MaxHashrate] I actually think this is a pricing error, bought something else to push it over $900 line to use Freeze120 code $120 off.
Lets see if i will get $120 off the other item if they cancel lol
[ninjin] It says that refunds or order modifications will be proportionate to the discounted price.
So they'll probably distribute the discount in proportion to the value of each item, and then refund just the card.
Let's say you rounded your purchase up to $900
Item 1: $769
Gets discounted to $769.00 - 120 * 769/900 = $666.47
Item 2: $131
Discounted to $131 - 120 * 131/900 = $113.53
[Blitzfx] Hard to believe 5060 ti 16gb was $120 cheaper 1 year ago
